skills.name: Lunatic - Risktaker
lines: Activate Lunatic with Status Risktaker on user (3 turns).
** +70% damage and healing (Multiplier: x1.7)
** Guaranteed physical and magical critical (continuous)
** Damage on self 20% of current HP before any attack move.
*** 20% self-damage only triggers once on Copy
*** No self-damage on EoT moves, but Critical rate & x1.7 damage boost applies
*** Counterattack moves doesn't get this effect.
*** 20% self-damage does not additionally apply to innate self-damage part of moves
*** 20% self-damage is rounded down for HP not divisible by 5. i.e. new HP its slightly more than 80%
* Activated by character's skill/passive

stellar_skills.name: Blade Storm
lines: Slash attack on a single enemy (XL)
* When not in Another Force: Stack Lingering Scent on target
** Lingering Scent cannot be inflicted on multiple targets
* Power and Speed of the user +100% (3 turns) and Give Shield to user with HP equal to 1500 HP (3 turns)
** Shield HP gets depleted before user HP and cannot be restored
* When target has Lingering Scent stacked: Inflicts 3 stacks of Weapon Break (Slash)
* When used during Stellar Burst: Perform Fatal Blow (Only if Fatal Blow is learned) and Activate Deep Shadow mode and Lunatic with Status Risktaker on user (3 turns)
